run_benchpress_benchmarks: run benchmark jobs using the Benchpress CLI with a specified benchmarks and jobs config file
list_benchpress_jobs: list all available benchmark jobs and their descriptions using the Benchpress list command
load_benchpress_config: load a BenchpressConfig from benchmarks, jobs, and toolchain config files with optional overrides
setup_benchpress_parser: setup the argparse CLI parser with subcommands for list, report, run, install, clean, info, and system check
parse_override_job_args: parse a colon-separated string to override job arguments for a specific benchmark job
